features: 3A Fast Charging Micro Cable: Enjoy high-speed charging up to 3A with stable current output, designed to safely power your Android phones, tablets, and Micro-USB gadgets without overheating.
Durable Nylon Braided Design: The Konnect X Micro Cable features a premium nylon-braided jacket that resists tangles, bends, and fraying — built to last over 10,000+ plug-in cycles.
1M Long for Convenient Use: With a 1-meter length, this Micro USB Cable offers perfect reach for home, office, and car charging — no more struggling with short wires.
Aluminium Alloy Connectors: Built with corrosion-resistant aluminium alloy shells, this Micro Cable ensures strong grip and long-term durability for daily use.
Fast Charging & Data Transfer: Transfer files, photos, and videos seamlessly with 480Mbps data transfer speed while charging your Micro USB devices at the same time.
Universal Compatibility: Works perfectly with Micro USB devices like Android smartphones, power banks, Bluetooth speakers, cameras, and more.
Safe & Reliable Performance: Equipped with smart chip protection to prevent short circuit, over-voltage, and overheating — ensuring stable charging every time.
description: Portronics Konnect X Micro Cable is a durable and high-speed charging solution for all your Micro-USB devices. With a 3A fast charging output and 480Mbps data transfer speed, it powers your smartphones, tablets, and accessories efficiently. The 1-meter nylon braided cable ensures flexibility, strength, and tangle-free use, while aluminium alloy connectors provide a premium, long-lasting finish. Engineered for safety and reliability, it offers protection against over-voltage and overheating. Whether you’re at home, in the car, or at work, the Konnect X Micro Cable keeps your devices charged and synced without compromise. Compatible with Android phones, power banks, Bluetooth speakers, and other Micro-USB gadgets, it’s the perfect everyday charging companion.
